result.feedback_interpretation: Measured diethyl malonate elutes much earlier than predicted across tested ratios, refuting transfer from phenyl-substituted malonate. Ring-nitrogen, β-ketoester, and methoxy-aromatic series show ratio-dependent prediction errors, including sign changes; the selected conditions test those patterns. The fluorobenzoate reversal remains weak evidence because its measured V2 difference is small. The brominated carboxylic-acid record has negative V2 and V2 below V1, so it is treated as a data-quality anomaly. Pending CW16 records have no measured responses.
